data.explanation: The Jobcenter has approved your Bürgergeld (basic income support) for the period shown. You still need to send your landlord's 2025 utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung) to the Jobcenter by 8 January 2027, because the heating cost share is currently only a provisional estimate. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Jobcenter; the app shows the deadline until when you can do this. If you miss it, the decision becomes final and can no longer be challenged. If you think the calculated amount is wrong, consider contacting a social counselling service (Sozialberatung) for advice.

items.quote: Gegen diese Entscheidung ist der Widerspruch zulässig. Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
